integrity: Exact rational checker accompanies a self-contained combinatorial fan and support-function proof; finite samples do not establish the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only torus-equivariant smooth small resolutions over the fixed target are counted; non-toric maps and abstract isomorphism classes are excluded. The isolated singularities, determinant charts, Gorenstein criterion, and threshold arrangement region counts have antecedents. Independent verification has not been performed.
title: Small resolutions of hypersimplex toric varieties and the threshold-arrangement projectivity criterion
